# Let me explore the symbol cycling by pressing UP multiple times on the first pink symbol
# and tracking hash changes. I'll batch UP presses and check after each.

# First, record current state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
pink_symbols = []
for node in seg['nodes']:
    if node['color'] == 'B':
        b = node['boundary']
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in b)
        if 51 <= min_row <= 57:
            pink_symbols.append({
                'hash': node['hash'],
                'min_col': min(p[1] for p in b),
                'pixels': node['pixels']
            })

print("Current pink symbols (left to right):")
pink_symbols.sort(key=lambda x: x['min_col'])
for s in pink_symbols:
    print(f"  col={s['min_col']}, hash={s['hash'][:8]}, pixels={s['pixels']}")

# Now let me try cycling through UP to see what variants exist
# I'll do UP 4 times and check the hash each time
for i in range(4):
    action(['UP'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    # Get hash of first pink symbol (col ~15)
    for node in seg['nodes']:
        if node['color'] == 'B':
            b = node['boundary']
            min_row = min(p[0] for p in b)
            min_col = min(p[1] for p in b)
            if 51 <= min_row <= 57 and 14 <= min_col <= 18:
                print(f"  After UP {i+1}: hash={node['hash'][:8]}, pixels={node['pixels']}")
                break
